name: agent-qa
description: Test web and mobile apps through a local CLI/MCP server with local model endpoints, memidex memory and validated self-improvement.
compatibility: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoints; upstream documents local LM Studio and Ollama configuration.
MCP over stdio or loopback HTTP for writing tests, running them and reading evidence.
Appium with UiAutomator2 for Android and XCUITest for iOS.
limitations: Requires Node.js 24+ and a separately configured model server. Specific model, hardware and host OS combinations were not runtime-tested for this catalog.
Visual checks need an image-capable model; text-only mode omits screenshots and cannot verify visual details.
Mobile testing needs Appium and platform tooling; iOS needs macOS and Xcode. Docker is required only for hooks.
App observations go to the configured model provider. Runs and MCP tools act without approval prompts; use limited test accounts and review plugins, which have full machine access.
Released versions send usage analytics unless analytics.privacy is true, and run/dashboard update checks contact npm; local model configuration does not guarantee offline operation.
FSL-1.1-ALv2 restricts use to the license's Permitted Purpose; each version transitions to Apache-2.0 after two years.

sources.note: Web/mobile testing, CLI/MCP, memidex memory, validated self-improvement and Node.js requirement.
Compatible endpoints, explicit local server examples and vision versus text-only behavior.
Local MCP transports and test, run, evidence and knowledge tools.
Node.js 24+, model setup and optional Docker requirement for hooks.
Appium drivers, Android tooling and macOS/Xcode requirement for iOS.
Application actions, plugin permissions, analytics opt-out and update-check network access.
Evidence-gated learning and corrections rather than changes to the agent's own code.
